description: Social Engineering Village at DEF CON 26 covers manipulation techniques, psychological tactics, and defensive strategies. The 10 talks explore phishing, vishing, pretexting, OSINT, red team operations, and using social engineering for positive purposes including child safety.

talks.title: On the Hunt Hacking the Hunt Group
talks.teaser: DEF CON SECTF champions demonstrate advanced hunting techniques—combining phishing, OSINT, and red team tactics to track and engage targets.

talks.title: From Introvert to SE The Journey
talks.teaser: Personal journey from introversion to becoming a skilled social engineer—lessons learned overcoming personality barriers to master manipulation.

talks.title: Swarm Intelligence and Augmented Reality Gaming
talks.teaser: Apply swarm intelligence concepts—collective autonomous behavior—to manipulate group dynamics and influence large-scale red team operations.

talks.title: MIster Sinatra Will Hack You Now
talks.teaser: Historical and modern manipulation techniques—how social engineers across millennia have influenced decision-making and shaped realities.

talks.title: Social Engineering From a CISOs Perspective
talks.teaser: CISO perspective on defending against social engineering—building organizational resilience through security awareness and cultural transformation.

talks.title: My Stripper Name Is Bubbles Sunset
talks.teaser: Analysis of a viral Facebook phishing campaign—how seemingly innocent naming games become effective social engineering attacks.

talks.title: Welcome to 2018: Full Speed to the Edge of the Abyss
talks.teaser: Exploration of human evolutionary paths and future trajectories—understanding psychological and behavioral trends shaping security landscapes.

talks.title: Hunting Predators SE Style
talks.teaser: Using social engineering techniques defensively—panel discussion on The Innocent Lives Foundation's efforts to identify and stop child predators.

talks.title: In-N-Out: That's What It's All About
talks.teaser: Physical and social tactics for gaining access—tools, techniques, and psychological approaches to overcome initial resistance in pretexting attacks.

talks.title: Social Engineering Course Projects for Undergrads
talks.teaser: Integrating social engineering and psychology into undergraduate cybersecurity curricula—practical course projects that teach offensive and defensive concepts.
